title: Concept: Memcached statistics disclosed
description: Memcached answered the stats command, so its text protocol is reachable without authentication and the counters it reports prove the cache is open.
applicability: Responses from a memcached text-protocol port.
risk: The reply proves unauthenticated access to the cache, which means get and set commands are also reachable and cached session data can be read or poisoned; MEDIUM because the statistics themselves are counters.
